name: Unpublish scheduled workflows on a staging n8n instance unless tagged

parameters.content:
## Unpublish timed workflows on a staging instance

### Who's it for
Teams that run separate dev, staging and production n8n instances and move workflows between them with Git source control, the CLI or copy and paste. A workflow copied into staging keeps its Schedule or polling trigger. Staging then runs your production jobs on its own, spending executions and calling real APIs.

### How it works
Every night the workflow lists all published workflows on this instance through the n8n API. It keeps the ones that have a Schedule, Cron, Interval or polling trigger and do not carry your allow-list tag. It never touches itself.

Dry run is on by default. In that mode it only posts a Slack report of what it would unpublish. Set `dryRun` to `false` and it unpublishes those workflows, then posts the same report.

### How to set up
1. Create an API key on the staging instance (Settings > n8n API).
2. Add an n8n API credential with that key and the base URL, for example `https://staging.example.com/api/v1`, and select it in both n8n nodes.
3. Edit **Set configuration**: tag name, instance label, dry run.
4. Tag the workflows that should keep running on staging (default tag `run-in-staging`).
5. Connect Slack and choose a channel, or replace the Slack node with email.
6. Run it once by hand and read the report before you publish it.

### Requirements
n8n API access on the instance (self-hosted, or a Cloud plan that includes the API). Slack, if you want the report there.

### How to customize
Trigger it right after your Git pull instead of at night, set `includePollingTriggers` to `false` to handle only schedules, or add trigger types in the Code node.

### 1. Configure
Allow-list tag, a label for the report, and the dry-run switch. **Leave `dryRun` on `true` until the report looks right.**

### 2. Find workflows that run on a timer
Lists published workflows, skips this one and anything tagged with the allow-list tag, keeps those with schedule or polling triggers.

### 3. Unpublish (only when dryRun is false) and report
The true branch unpublishes each workflow. Both branches end in the same report, posted to Slack.
